title: Who regulates what
description: What PesaSense is, and what it is not.
heading: The honest picture
asOf: As of 1 October 2026. Status to be confirmed.
education: This is education, not financial advice.
neverHold: We never hold your funds, your keys, or your M-Pesa balance.
notLicensed: PesaSense is not a licensed exchange or investment adviser. That status is still to be confirmed.
partner: The on-ramp partner's licence status is to be confirmed. We do not call a partner licensed until that is checked.
privacyPaths: On the web app, M-Pesa statements are read on your phone and stay there. If you use the Telegram bot, you send the statement to the bot so it can build your picture — that path leaves your phone. Either way, you approve every purchase; nothing is sent on its own.
